images.description: Diamond and sapphire bow-shaped brooch that belonged to Jackie Onassis, featuring carved rock crystal center with diamonds and sapphires

sidebar.text: This brooch belonged to Jackie Onassis. It's made with sapphires and diamonds inlaid around rock crystal. Esteemed for its craftsmanship and heritage, it was offered to me for $150,000.

transcription.raw_text:
CHAPTER 10

JACKIE ONASSIS' DIAMOND SAPPHIRE BROOCH

Welcome the Good and the Bad

"Man never made any material as resilient as the human spirit."
—BERNARD WILLIAMS

"Indeed, this life is a test. It is a test of many things—of our convictions and priorities, our faith and our faithfulness, our patience and our resilience, and in the end, our ultimate desires."
—SHERI L. DEW

I was a competitive, eager child, who could be very hard on myself. I remember once standing in a parking lot after a football game unable to speak through the convulsions of my sobs and snot and tears. I was convinced I had lost my team the playoff game. My dad knelt down beside me. He put his hand on my shoulder and said, "Jon, you are hurting now, I know. There are times like this. But this is temporary. Son, it's not about when bad things happen.
